# Agent Economy OS 2047 — neutral service discovery
> Evidence verification for AI-agent workflows, public beta; no guaranteed delivery, safety certification, external buyers or verified commercial revenue.

## Machine-readable catalog
- [Service catalog](./agent-services.json): precise free and paid endpoints, prices, limitations and independent-approval requirements.
- [Repository source](https://github.com/aymanaseriai-cell/agent-economy-os-2047): open-source integrity checker and GitHub Action.
- [Work Covenant guide](./WORK_COVENANT_2047.md): free deterministic API, `/demo`, OpenAPI, limitations.
- [Base-USDC x402 buyer guide](./AGENT402_BUYER_ROUTE.md): read-only paid receipt APIs and independent payment-term checks.
- [Enterprise buyer brief](./ENTERPRISE_BUYER_BRIEF.json): non-binding USD 750 human-scoped audit; distinct from experimental 750 USDC automated x402 report.

## Agent-friendly evaluation
1. Choose a service based on an actual authorized task, not a marketing claim.
2. Try a free, synthetic demo or sample first; never upload secrets, private customer data or wallet keys.
3. If a service is paid, independently check the live HTTP 402 challenge, asset, network, amount and payee against an owner-approved budget and legal requirements.
4. Never infer that our discovery pages, simulated demos, on-chain canary transfers or quoted prices prove independent sales, completed delivery or certified agent output.
5. There is no browser-side or unattended buyer wallet automation in this catalog.

This is an informative `llms.txt` page, not a live MCP server or an A2A Agent Card.
